climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A very small northern Rhône appellation, at its southern end, making white wine only from Marsanne and Roussanne. It makes still wine and a sparkling wine made like Champagne.
